api_scan.method: Decoded each SHA-deduplicated text response body; recursively scanned parseable JSON keys and values for SKU/JAN/GTIN/barcode/MPN/model/item number/ingredients/spec/material and product title/item IDs; separately parsed 118 deduplicated request body payloads. Raw request payloads and user/account identifiers are not exported.
specific_code_keys_absent_from_api_json_: specification/material fields for target SKU mapping
api_scan.key_interpretation: Parsed API JSON yielded productId/itemId, itemName/title, and price fields, plus delivery-option title/option fields from itemOptions. No API or request payload contained a seller variant SKU, JAN/GTIN/barcode, manufacturer part number, product model code, ingredients, or a product-specific dimension/material table beyond the storefront HTML. The `itemOptions` free option titles refer to delivery/shipping acknowledgments, not the item variant.

api_scan_scope_warning: Absence statements concern the scanned separate API JSON/request payloads, not HTML-embedded product JSON. Later full native JSON acquisition contains JAN evidence.

final_guarded_protocol.form: AU01 options dialog, purchase/cart guard on
final_guarded_protocol.interpretation: GET /api/items/321039323/itemOptions is a 200 response and returns three free delivery-method/shipping acknowledgments. It adds no SKU, model, JAN, or physical product specs. The cart form submit was prevented and all non-GET/HEAD routes were blocked; the request ledger contains no cart POST. Three UI option choices changed hidden `sku` indices in the DOM, but no variant API response carrying a concrete seller SKU/JAN appeared. See protocol/live-au01-guarded-04/guarded-actions.json and network.json.

request_payload_audit.findings: POST /api/logger payloads include target itemId values and app error context. Analytics/event payloads include product-page title and/or visible price for tracking. No captured payload includes a selected `sku`/`skuId` mapping, JAN/GTIN/barcode, maker part number, ingredient list, or measurement table. Query parameter values and user/account/anonymous ID fields are omitted from all indexes.

rendered_snapshots.note: Frame snapshots include repeated main-frame snapshots as page.frames[0]; they are not 126 distinct iframe pages. There were 12 distinct non-main frame host/path/status combinations across captured contexts. Most successful non-main documents were advertising synchronization pages; Wowma plus promotion/recommendation documents failed with 503.

method_limitations: The audit deduplicated saved response bodies by SHA-256 and parsed JSON plus bounded key/name scans over text responses, request bodies and rendered HTML snapshots.
Targeted manual review focused on structured marketplace APIs, comparison/recommendation/shop ranking, logger payloads, `itemOptions`, and the external document/frame types.
This is not a full semantic reverse engineering of every JavaScript bundle, ad tracker, third-party endpoint, or possible UI state.
Raw request payload values, query values, anonymous/user identifiers, and cookies were not copied into audit outputs.

A noHTTP capture means no HTTP status was observed; `ERR_FAILED` may be network/proxy failure, `ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT.Inspector` is the guarded non-GET behavior for final protocol capture, and 25 requests had no failure string before the bounded capture ended.
